candidate_sentence_map.S1: During the financial year 2025, AS Pro Kapital Grupp achieved significant financial and operational growth, turning a net loss into a strong and profitable performance across its markets.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Total revenue for the twelve months of 2025 reached 53.2 million euros, representing a substantial increase compared to 18.2 million euros in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Fourth quarter revenue also grew to 18.9 million euros from 7.5 million euros in the corresponding period of the previous year.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: The significant rise in revenue was primarily driven by the handover of completed apartments in the Kalaranna and Uus-Kindrali developments in Tallinn, as well as the City Villas project in Vilnius, whereas apartment handovers in 2024 were largely limited due to project timelines.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Gross profit for 2025 rose to 18.8 million euros with a gross profit margin of 35 percent, compared to 5.4 million euros and a 30 percent margin in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Operating profit improved sharply to 14.7 million euros, or 28 percent of revenue, compared to just 123 thousand euros in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: The Group recorded a net profit of 12.0 million euros for 2025, recovering from a net loss of 3.9 million euros in the previous year.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Fourth quarter net profit stood at 6.0 million euros compared to 187 thousand euros in the final quarter of 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Basic earnings per share turned positive at 0.22 euros for the twelve months of 2025, compared to negative 0.06 euros in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Cash generated from operating activities improved to 10.8 million euros in 2025, contrasting with cash used of 10.4 million euros during 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: Total assets increased to 124.5 million euros as of 31 December 2025, up from 118.8 million euros a year earlier, while total liabilities decreased to 61.2 million euros from 67.5 million euros.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: Total equity rose to 63.3 million euros from 51.2 million euros, and net asset value per share increased to 1.12 euros from 0.89 euros.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: The debt to equity ratio improved to 0.97 at the end of 2025 from 1.32 at the end of 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Return on assets reached 10.1 percent, and return on equity was 21.0 percent.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Several key business events marked the reporting period.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: In August 2025, the Group partially repaid 9.405 million euros of its senior secured callable fixed rate bonds, reducing the outstanding nominal amount to 10.545 million euros.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Unsecured bonds remained at an outstanding nominal amount of 8.2 million euros.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Total bank loan debt stood at 23.6 million euros at year end, following 31.5 million euros received and 25.7 million euros repaid during the year.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: Operationally, the Group commenced construction on the Blue Marine residential building in Riga in July 2025 and completed the Kalaranna district and the white building in the Uus-Kindrali project in Tallinn.
candidate_sentence_map.S20: Additionally, on 1 September 2025, the Group acquired an additional 10 percent ownership interest in Preatoni Nuda Proprietà in Italy, raising its stake to 77.5 percent, though it recognized a full goodwill impairment loss of 863 thousand euros on this Italian subsidiary during the year.
candidate_sentence_map.S21: Overall, the company demonstrated solid execution, robust financial recovery, and disciplined capital management throughout 2025.
